_comment: Trail looks still being shown to Alan as 3D videos (tools/art/trail_preview.py reads this after config/trails.json; same words as there). paper_hearts is OK'd in look but saved for a holiday set (Alan 2026-11-16). Not in the game: a trail moves to config/trails.json once Alan OKs its video and src/client/PlaneTrails.luau can draw it. Extra words used here: models heart, note, notes, petal, curl (would be uploaded), ball, cube, bar, strip (plain shapes the game draws itself), square (a flat square particle, Roblox's own picture); models dart, butterfly and jog (a bent circuit trace) (would be uploaded), trace, board and chip (plain blocks); looks fire (its own light, never shaded), paper (crisp folds), bright (a lit block), glass (a see-through goo bubble); `upright` (stands up, turning like a sign), `align: grid` (square to the plane as it was when the piece left, long side mostly along the path), `axes` (a grid piece's long side: how often along the path, across it, up), `lattice` (studs: pieces start on a grid this wide, so they line up), `level` (flies nose-first along the path, right way up), `run` (studs a second: races back along the path), `jump` (studs: snaps sideways 8 times a second).
